payload.title: [sfu-media-5] mediasoup worker-init promise is poisoned by a transient failure — backend permanently bricked
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING sfu-media-5 (medium/stability, confidence=high, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/calls/mediasoup-sfu-backend.ts
LINES: 269-297

WHAT: #ensureWorker caches the in-flight init promise: `if (!this.#workerInit) this.#workerInit = this.#startWorker();` then `this.#worker = await this.#workerInit`. If #startWorker rejects (mediasoup import fails, or createWorker throws transiently — e.g. ENOMEM, no free ports, EAGAIN spawning the C++ worker), the await throws so #worker stays undefined, but #workerInit retains the *rejected* promise. Every subsequent ensureRouter→#ensureWorker sees #workerInit is truthy and re-awaits the same rejected promise, returning the original failure forever. Nothing resets #workerInit on failure (only close() at line 261 clears it).

IMPACT: A single transient worker-creation failure permanently disables the SFU backend for the process: all future calls get the same stale error even after the underlying condition (memory pressure, port contention) clears. Recovery requires a full close()/restart. Self-inflicted outage from a recoverable hiccup.

SUGGESTED FIX: On failure, clear the cached init: `try { this.#worker = await this.#workerInit; } catch (e) { this.#workerInit = undefined; throw e; }` so the next call retries a fresh worker.
